map.核心计算公式：加入量 = W×(目标%−初始%)÷(原料含量%×回收率%−目标%: Key formula: addition = W×(target%−initial%)÷(alloy content%×recovery%−target%), balanced on the final melt mass
map.原料加入量 = W × (目标含量 − 初始含量) ÷ (原料合金含量 × 回收: Raw material addition = W × (target content − initial content) ÷ (alloy content × recovery − target content), all in decimal fractions
map.5t 钢液需增 Cr 至 18%，原料为高碳铬铁(含Cr 60%，回收率 95%: For 5 t of steel raised to 18% Cr with high-carbon ferrochrome (60% Cr, 95% recovery): addition = 5×0.18 ÷ (0.60×0.95 − 0.18) ≈ 2.31 t; the melt becomes about 7.31 t and Cr is exactly 18%.
map.多元素目标时联立终态衡算，同时计入各合金自身带入的质量，避免逐一近似导致终态偏低: With multiple target elements, solve the final-state balance jointly and count the mass introduced by every alloy, avoiding sequential approximations that leave the final composition low.
map.按终态衡算：原料加入量 = W × (目标含量 − 初始含量) ÷ (原料合金含: Final-state balance: addition = W × (target content − initial content) ÷ (alloy content × recovery − target content), all in decimal fractions. Recovery reflects the actual yield of the element in smelting; subtracting the target content in the denominator offsets the dilution caused by the larger melt mass after alloying.
map.5 t 钢液目标 Cr 18%（初始 0），用高碳铬铁（含 Cr 60%、回收率: For 5 t of steel targeting 18% Cr (initial 0) with high-carbon ferrochrome (60% Cr, 95% recovery): addition = 5×0.18 ÷ (0.60×0.95 − 0.18) = 0.9 ÷ 0.39 ≈ 2.31 t. The melt becomes about 7.31 t, carrying 2.31×0.60×0.95 ≈ 1.317 t Cr, i.e. 18.0%. Using the old approximation of 1.58 t leaves the final Cr at only about 13.7%.
map.用公式中的 (目标−初始)，并按加入后钢液总量衡算；若钢液已含部分 Cr，只需补: Use (target − initial) in the formula and balance against the final melt mass. If the steel already contains some Cr, only the difference is topped up, so the addition drops and over-alloying is avoided.
map.合金加入量 = 钢水量 × (目标成分 − 初始成分) ÷ (合金元素含量 ×: Alloy addition = steel mass × (target − initial) ÷ (alloy content × recovery − target), all in decimal fractions and balanced on the final melt mass
map.各元素目标含量合计超出原料可带入能力，无法同时达到，请降低目标或提高合金含量/回: The combined target contents exceed what the raw materials can supply, so they cannot all be met at once. Lower the targets or raise alloy content/recovery.
